attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_clinical_analysis_pipeline

steps:
  - id: receive_pdf_upload
    op: receive_upload
    params:
      file_type: application/pdf
      require_authentication: true
      max_file_size_mb: 100
    output: uploaded_pdf

  - id: extract_text
    op: pdf_text_extraction
    params:
      source: "{{uploaded_pdf}}"
      primary_method: digital_extraction
      fallback_method: ocr
      ocr_engine: tesseract
      preserve_structure: true
    output: raw_extracted_text

  - id: anonymize_text
    op: pii_anonymization
    params:
      input_text: "{{raw_extracted_text}}"
      hard_gate: true
      abort_pipeline_on_failure: true
      methods:
        - named_entity_recognition
        - regex_pattern_matching
        - date_shifting
      entity_types:
        - name
        - dob
        - ssn
        - mrn
        - address
        - phone
        - email
        - insurance_id
      validation: strict
    output: anonymized_text
    on_failure: abort

  - id: ingest_into_wiki
    op: wiki_ingest
    params:
      content: "{{anonymized_text}}"
      encryption_at_rest: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      case_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.case_id}}"
      create_pages_by_section: true
      tag_source: pdf_upload
    output: wiki_state

  - id: check_wiki_page_threshold
    op: conditional_gate
    params:
      condition: "{{wiki_state.page_count}} >= 3"
      wait_if_unmet: false
      proceed_if_met: true
    output: wiki_threshold_met

  - id: pubmed_literature_search
    op: literature_search
    params:
      enabled: "{{wiki_threshold_met}}"
      source: pubmed
      query_from: "{{wiki_state.key_terms}}"
      max_results: 50
      filters:
        - peer_reviewed: true
      encrypt_results: true
    output: literature_results

  - id: adversarial_analysis_loop
    op: adversarial_loop
    params:
      input_wiki: "{{wiki_state}}"
      literature: "{{literature_results}}"
      anonymized_text: "{{anonymized_text}}"
      max_iterations: 8
      convergence_threshold: 0.10
      encrypt_prompts: true
      encrypt_responses: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      two_tier_separation:
        documented_findings: true
        inferred_findings: true
      sub_steps:
        - id: run_iteration
          op: llm_adversarial_pass
          params:
            iteration: "{{current_iteration}}"
            challenger_prompt: true
            defender_prompt: true
            encrypt_at_rest: true
          output: iteration_result

        - id: check_convergence
          op: convergence_check
          params:
            current_result: "{{iteration_result}}"
            previous_result: "{{previous_iteration_result}}"
            threshold: 0.10
            metric: delta_score
          output: convergence_status

        - id: loop_control
          op: loop_decision
          params:
            converged: "{{convergence_status.converged}}"
            iteration: "{{current_iteration}}"
            max_iterations: 8
          output: continue_loop
    output: adversarial_findings

  - id: validate_nct_numbers
    op: nct_validation
    params:
      findings: "{{adversarial_findings}}"
      validation_source: clinicaltrials_gov_api
      remove_invalid: true
      flag_unverified: true
    output: validated_findings

  - id: generate_two_tier_report
    op: report_generation
    params:
      findings: "{{validated_findings}}"
      literature: "{{literature_results}}"
      tiers:
        - tier: documented
          label: "Evidence-Based Documented Findings"
          source_required: true
        - tier: inferred
          label: "AI-Inferred Findings"
          confidence_scores: true
      separation_enforced: true
      encrypt_content: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
      format: structured_json_and_pdf
    output: two_tier_report

  - id: update_wiki_with_findings
    op: wiki_update
    params:
      case_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.case_id}}"
      content: "{{validated_findings}}"
      report_reference: "{{two_tier_report.id}}"
      encryption_at_rest: true
      encryption_algorithm: AES-256-GCM
    output: updated_wiki_state

  - id: log_pipeline_run
    op: audit_log
    params:
      pipeline_id: full_clinical_analysis_pipeline
      case_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.case_id}}"
      steps_completed:
        - receive_pdf_upload
        - extract_text
        - anonymize_text
        - ingest_into_wiki
        - check_wiki_page_threshold
        - pubmed_literature_search
        - adversarial_analysis_loop
        - validate_nct_numbers
        - generate_two_tier_report
        - update_wiki_with_findings
      adversarial_iterations: "{{adversarial_findings.iterations_run}}"
      convergence_achieved: "{{adversarial_findings.converged}}"
      timestamp: "{{now}}"
      user_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.user_id}}"
      encrypt_log: true

  - id: final_pii_validation
    op: pii_scan
    params:
      content: "{{two_tier_report}}"
      scan_mode: exhaustive
      entity_types:
        - name
        - dob
        - ssn
        - mrn
        - address
        - phone
        - email
        - insurance_id
      fail_on_detection: true
      abort_delivery_on_failure: true
    output: pii_validation_result

  - id: serve_encrypted_report
    op: secure_delivery
    params:
      report: "{{two_tier_report}}"
      pii_clean: "{{pii_validation_result.clean}}"
      require_authentication: true
      user_id: "{{uploaded_pdf.user_id}}"
      encryption_in_transit: TLS_1_3
      encryption_at_rest: AES-256-GCM
      access_logging: true
    output: delivery_confirmation
